programme.sub-title: Episode 3: US Boston, Medically-tailored Nutritious Meals For Patients
programme.desc: Not only does food fills the stomach, but it warms the hearts too. In this brand-new series, follow Danny Yeo and Darren Lim on their journeys, to witness how the Taiwan homeless, the Boston disadvantaged patients, the stray animals and foreign workers in Singapore gains a helping hand from big hearted souls - those who cook for a worthy cause. 食物传递味道，也传递人情。一顿饭不只给予温饱，也能点亮一个人和一群人的生活。主持人杨君伟和林明伦到访台湾街友、波士顿的弱势病患、新加坡的客工和流浪猫狗，见证善心人散发爱心，把特别的食物献给特别的受益人。

programme.title: Say It Right!
programme.desc: As the saying goes: the customer is always right. This episode, Tosh and Pam serve as restaurant service crew for a day. They are challenged on memorising the menu, serving customers, recommending dishes and coping with difficult customers. After training for a few episodes, have both improved tremendously in their conversational Chinese? Can they calmly respond to inquiries from customers?

programme.title: Your World In Mine
programme.desc: Jian Qiang and Jia Yun have three children, eldest daughter Tian Xi, second son Tian Wei, and the youngest son Tian Cai. When Tian Cai was diagnosed with intellectual disability, Jia Yun’s world crashed, but fortunately Jian Qiang was there to be her pillar of support. The children are now grown up, and they thought the toughest period is over, but unbeknownst to them, the biggest crisis their family will face is yet to come… 郑坚强和李家云两人有三个孩子，大姐郑天希、二哥郑天伟、还有小弟郑天才。在小儿子天才确诊是智障儿后，家云近乎崩溃，感觉天就要塌下来，所幸乐观豁达的坚强努力的帮她撑起一片天。两夫妻排除万难把孩子拉扯长大，转眼二十多年过去了，三个子女已长大成人。原以为黑暗的苦日子已过去，殊不知，真正的暴风雨即将来临…

One simple idea can indeed make the world a better place! 生活一点通，利用一个有趣又简单的点子来解决生活中所遇到的难题。看万家三宝依依、典典和万世通在面对生活状况时，如何发挥创意，利用实用的小妙招解决问题，分享生活中的小窍门。动动脑筋，付诸行动，一点通，万事通，让生活更美好！

Under his leadership, the Transformation Alliance has become a team that upholds justice and protects life!

programme.title: Tuesday Report : Gone Before Goodbye
programme.desc: Some goodbyes never get to happen. A husband. An unborn child. A parent. A beloved pet. Every loss leaves a wound. In Chinese culture, death is taboo and grief is weakness — so we learn to stay silent. But silence never heals. Gone Before Goodbye unfolds through intimate sharing of grief in its rawest form. Learning to say goodbye isn't about forgetting. It's about carrying love forward. 有些告别，永远来不及发生。失去丈夫、失去未曾谋面的孩子、失去父母、失去相伴多年的宠物——每一种失去，都是一道无声的伤。在华人社会，死亡是禁忌，悲伤是软弱，我们学会沉默，却从未学会告别。五集纪录片《来不及说再见》，跟随多位主人公穿越悲伤最真实的样貌——凌乱、沉重、无处安放。我们要如何学会告别，接受心中的悲痛并不是为了遗忘——而是为了带着爱，重新出发？

programme.title: Eat Better, Live Better
programme.desc: Eggs are packed with protein, lutein, and lecithin, which helps boost good cholesterol. While soft-boiled eggs are popular, fully cooked ones aid better nutrient absorption. Storing eggs on fridge doors can breed bacteria due to frequent opening. Chefs Tung-ching and Andy create dishes like steamed eggs with king crab and huadiao wine, and poached eggs wrapped in dace fish. Luk Ho Ming visits a farm to learn how eggs are produced and selected.

programme.title: Find Me A Singaporean : The World's My Stage
programme.desc: As our nation celebrates its 60th anniversary, it is perhaps timely that we visit some Singaporeans who have made their marks overseas. From top fashion designer in Paris to Michelin Chef in Copenhagen, from a musician in Reunion Island to a doctor in Maesot, from a young F3 racer in Europe to another young kite racer flying across the seas, this season’s Find Me a Singaporean celebrates the outstanding achievements of some Singaporeans. 为庆祝新加坡建国60周年，新一季的《稀游记之世界我的舞台》特地走访8名在世界不同角落、不同领域大放异彩的新加坡人。从巴黎的顶尖设计师到哥本哈根的米其林三星厨师，从驰骋欧洲乃至世界的运动员到偏远国度发光发热的教育家、音乐家和医生，这些新加坡人有着什么样动人的故事呢？

programme.title: Your World In Mine
programme.desc: Jian Qiang and Jia Yun have three children, eldest daughter Tian Xi, second son Tian Wei, and the youngest son Tian Cai. When Tian Cai was diagnosed with intellectual disability, Jia Yun’s world crashed, but fortunately Jian Qiang was there to be her pillar of support. The children are now grown up, and they thought the toughest period is over, but unbeknownst to them, the biggest crisis their family will face is yet to come… 郑坚强和李家云两人有三个孩子，大姐郑天希、二哥郑天伟、还有小弟郑天才。在小儿子天才确诊是智障儿后，家云近乎崩溃，感觉天就要塌下来，所幸乐观豁达的坚强努力的帮她撑起一片天。两夫妻排除万难把孩子拉扯长大，转眼二十多年过去了，三个子女已长大成人。原以为黑暗的苦日子已过去，殊不知，真正的暴风雨即将来临…

programme.title: King Of Culinary
programme.desc: Best Entertainment Programme - Star Awards 2021 | King of Culinary is a brand new cooking competition, in arena style! Uncovering the hidden culinary talents, and pitting them against top local chefs for a cook-off. These talents could be teachers, lawyers, designers with a day job, but when they get home, they turn into highly-skilled chefs in their own kitchen. In every episode for a total of 13 weeks, the culinary talent challenges three celebrity chefs in three different rounds. Who will emerge as the final winner? Our renowned chefs or our hidden talent? 三把刀，崭新的厨艺擂台比赛！我们常听说律师平时打官司，周末变厨师；老师、设计师、家庭主妇等不少烹调高手其实就在民间！节目发掘这些隐藏的烹调素人， 与三位明星大厨展开大对决！！民间高手得把三个名厨一个一个干掉，才能夺得三把刀和丰富奖金！刀光剑影，谁的刀最锋利！是名厨呢？还是卧虎藏龙的高手呢？三把刀，精彩可期！

programme.title: Keep It Down
programme.desc: Yijun is a urologist and works alongside gynaecologist Weikang and psychotherapist Zac. They treat patients struggling with intimate conditions. As they heal others, their emotional wounds resurface. Yijun is haunted by the trauma of a flasher; Zac likes mature women who are 20 years older; and Weikang is diagnosed with testicular cancer, they slowly learn that healing begins with themselves. 一君是一名泌尿科医生，与妇科医生伟康及心理治疗师Zac一起，接诊那些有难以启齿的疾病患者。在治愈他人的过程中，他们各自的情感创伤逐渐浮现。一君仍被暴露狂事件的阴影困扰，Zac偏爱年长二十岁的成熟女性，伟康则被诊断出睾丸癌。他们也慢慢明白，真正的疗愈，始于直面自己。

programme.title: Talk of The Town
programme.desc: A half-hour talk-show segment in Hello Singapore which brings together diverse voices and expert opinions to thought-provoking discussions on wide range of issues. Incorporating online polls which gather public opinions, the segment creates a space that allows for multi viewpoints in the studio from Monday to Friday.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Focus provides timely reports and analyses on international news and current affairs from Singapore's perspective. 《焦点》追踪国际时事，实地报道区域课题，以新加坡的视角分析时局发展的前因后果和潜在影响。

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

programme.title: Big Biz Duel
programme.desc: Zhao Kai meets with Li Ziguang, the head of Hongshan, and successfully secured the investment. Unable to take control of Shidai, Qichao tries to bribe gangsters to attack Zhao Kai and prevent Shidai’s second public listing.

programme.title: Golden City
programme.desc: This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Yijun discovers that Xingyun has a family and that Ah Li is his granddaughter, leaving Liufang upset and angry. Meanwhile, Liufang secretly follows Haodong and his students to a Cantonese opera theatre without telling Yijun.

programme.title: Axian’s Street Journeys
programme.desc: A culinary and travel documentary series where host Axian (Jason Tan) explores the historic streets of Malaysia, tracing local history through food, traditional trades, and the lives of community residents.

programme.title: Road Trip Down Under
programme.sub-title: Up-close encounters with koalas and kangaroos
programme.desc: Jinny Ng, Karl Ting, and Joey Thye kick off a road trip from Brisbane to the Gold Coast, teasing each other over age and food. They share how their friendship grew, visit a sanctuary to meet koalas and kangaroos, then enjoy a sunset BBQ. Old singing clips spark playful teasing, as Jinny reflects on how her personality has changed.

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: (Live) News Tonight
programme.desc: Daily evening updates on top local news and world news.

programme.title: Journey To Jianghu
programme.sub-title: Episode 15: Yunnan: Visiting the Sect Leader in Shangri-La
programme.desc: In this final episode, the duo explore Shangri-La, driving up mountain roads beside grazing cattle and gazing at Balagezong’s snow peaks. At a highland pasture, the Sect Leader serves butter tea and shares his story of building roads to connect the region. As night falls, the brothers sit by a fire, recalling filming memories, expressing gratitude, and opening up about family regrets with heartfelt honesty.

programme.title: The Glory
programme.desc: Abandoned as a child, Zhuang Han Yan grows up in the southern countryside before returning to her family in the capital. She catches the eye of Fu Yun Xi, a deputy minister with a mysterious illness, who sees her as an ideal wife. As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: Lost You Forever
programme.desc: Cang Xuan managed to overcome the suppression and schemes of his fifth and seventh uncles and successfully ascended to the throne of the Western Yan Kingdom. In order to help Cang Xuan with his grand ambitions, Xiao Yao planned to rely on the unity of the Central Plains clans to assist Cang Xuan, and arranged a marriage alliance with Chi Shui Feng Long.

programme.title: Travel with Parents
programme.desc: Embarking on a magical journey, Axian, Jiang Han and Hui Mei gift their parents with the luxury of companionship, creating unforgettable memories filled with love and romance. 陪伴，是世上最奢侈的礼物。阿贤将联同江瀚和慧敏带着父母去旅行，帮他们完成旅行愿望清单，用父母的速度旅行，双手相握一起看世界，是再多钱也换不到的人生体验，一起踏上奇幻浪漫的旅途。

programme.title: Baby Blues
programme.desc: 安哥蛋店的老板叫陈安,大家都叫他Uncle Tan. 陈安的老婆杨水莲精明能干,管理着店里的大小事情,陈安对老婆唯唯喏喏.店里唯一的伙计阿亮也怕这个老板娘三分.陈巧花是陈安的大女儿,也是陈安的得力帮手,性格内向,不施脂粉,每天只会埋首工作,38岁了仍嫁杏无期,因此非常不得水莲的宠爱. 蛋店的生意不错.每天,巧花就会第一个到蛋店开门,准备把蛋送到各个订户去.这时,在巴刹卖蛋的刘凤萍总会跑来,在蛋堆里东挑西选的大作记号,好让巧花把最大最新鲜的鸡蛋留给她。水莲最讨厌凤萍趁她不在的时候偷偷来选蛋.两人虽有生意上的往来,但也势如水火. 巧云是巧花的妹妹,姐妹俩相差十几岁.风华正茂，走在时代前端的巧云活泼好动,不喜欢朝九晚五的生活,当导游是她最终的目标.偏偏在导游考试那天却误了时间,幸水莲飞车载送她到考场,她才能顺利的参加考试. 水莲和巧花送蛋到巴刹,凤萍发现鸡蛋上没有自己作的记号,就和水莲起了争执,两人争吵时,水莲的手机跌坏,要凤萍赔钱,凤萍赶着去接儿子海深出狱,无奈赔了水莲一百块. 水莲买了新手机,到处向人炫耀,不料被抢,海深经过,帮水莲抢回手机,让巧花对他留下好印象. 海深出狱回家.发现到屋里屋外都挂满了黄丝带.小外甥女欣仪告诉他黄丝带的故事,表示欢迎他回家.海深为欣仪的细腻心思感动不已…… 巧云夜归,巧花不放心到楼下等她,不料却被巧云当色郎打.巧花额头肿起了一大块，巧云以粉底帮她掩饰。不巧隔天出了小意外，海深以为是自己用花瓶伤了巧花，就急急拿熟鸡蛋为巧花搓揉。巧花和海深近距离接触，一颗心简直就如小鹿乱撞 ....

programme.title: SG Explorers
programme.desc: We always say that Singapore is so boring! But statistics from Singapore Tourism Board suggested otherwise. Just last year, tourists visiting Singapore has increased from 16.4 million to 17.4 million since 2016! You might be sick of the typical places of interest available in Singapore but hey, there’s more to Singapore than you think. Join our tour as we re-introduce Singapore through unique and strictly no trespassing places! 人们常说，新加坡很boring！然而，新加坡旅游局数据却不是这么说！光是去年，入境我国的旅客人数就从前年的1640万人增加到1740万人。谁说新加坡boring的？！或许你已经厌倦了千篇一律的旅游景点，现在是时候让全民动起来，一起出去走走，寻找鲜为人知、闲人勿扰的景点，以独特的视角，重新认识新加坡！

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: The owner of My One and Only, Ma Limin, aspires to become a real estate developer with her son Hao Renpin, offering one-stop services for property purchase and renovation with her husband Hao Haojian and interior designer Wan Defu, who run How Luck Renovation. Their interactions with their clients reveal stories about different types of families. 马丽敏是“只此一家”的老板娘，怀抱着做发展商的目标，带着儿子郝仁品在地产界闯荡。丈夫郝健和室内设计师万德福负责“好运装修公司”，一家人一起包办客户房屋买卖和装修的需要。透过他们所接待的客户，看到形形色色和“家”有关的故事…

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

programme.title: Brothers on the Camino
programme.desc: Pilgrimage becomes the reason to leave home and set out on a journey. Three companions walk side by side on the long-awaited pilgrimage route of their dreams, covering more than 800km and enduring the triple trials of physical strength, endurance, and spirit. They travel along the Camino de Santiago in Spain and Japan’s Kumano Kodo (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), showcasing the charm and cultural depth of these two great pilgrimage routes. 朝圣，成为离开家乡、出发旅行的理由。三人并肩踏上憧憬已久的朝圣之路，经历了超过800公里，体力、耐力、心灵的三重考验，走访位于西班牙的朝圣之路（圣雅各之路）和日本的熊野古道（世界遗产），展现东西方两条朝圣路线的魅力与文化内涵！

Call Us Wunderkind follows child prodigies across Singapore, Thailand and the Philippines, and the families who have rebuilt their lives around them. But who decides a child is a prodigy? And what does it take to keep one going? Across six episodes, the series counts the time, money and attention poured into a single gift, and asks who really pays. programme.title: Call Us Wunderkind
programme.desc: What if your child could do what most adults never will? Call Us Wunderkind follows child prodigies across Singapore, Thailand and the Philippines, and the families who have rebuilt their lives around them. But who decides a child is a prodigy? And what does it take to keep one going? Across six episodes, the series counts the time, money and attention poured into a single gift, and asks who really pays. What happens when a child who never fails, does? Where does a prodigy go to just be a kid? When a talent goes viral, who controls the story? And when the applause dies down, who are they without it? With insights from gifted-education experts, psychologists and former prodigies, Call Us Wunderkind takes an intimate look at childhoods lived at full speed, and asks what it really means to grow up extraordinary.

programme.title: Jockey Boy
programme.desc: Dao, a young jockey, has raced horses since he was five to support his struggling family. When his baby brother Fatih is born, Dao is sent to live with a horse owner, where he works and studies by dim stable light, dreaming of becoming a vet. After witnessing a rider fall during training, Dao is gripped by fear. His father takes him to a shaman, who blesses him and promises he’ll be safe. But Dao is troubled by talk of Fatih becoming a jockey too. On race day, standing at the starting line, Dao carries both hope and worry. How long can he keep racing—and at what cost to himself and his family?

programme.title: Drugs 2.0
programme.desc: The global drug landscape is being reshaped by the fast-moving challenge of new psychoactive substances (NPS) –compounds engineered to replicate the highs of drugs like MDMA, heroin and cannabis. They are constantly evolving and far more unpredictable. Created by modifying the chemical structure of traditional illicit drugs to circumvent drug laws, they can evade routine drug tests, leaving global drug regulators racing to respond. In Singapore, these mostly synthetic drugs remain a small but growing threat. New laws now cover any substance that can produce a psychoactive effect. But as younger users are drawn in by the illusion of safer highs, authorities warn the problem could escalate if left unchecked. CNA follows the trail from clandestine labs in India to Singapore’s forensic labs, where scientists scramble to decode the ever-changing chemistry behind these drugs.
